## Property Overview

The Grand — Royal Banquet & Lawns provides event venues along Raibareli Road in Bindaua, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The grounds include four open-air lawns and courtyards plus an indoor air-conditioned banquet hall. The facilities accommodate private events, wedding ceremonies, receptions, cultural functions, and corporate meetings ranging from 250 to 2,500 guests.
